## Supervisor v0.5.2

### New
- **Change things in the calendar:** right-click an item to edit, delete or postpone it. In the month view, drag an item to another day to move it. Select items and press **Delete** to remove them. A deleted week of a repeating meeting can be brought back with a right-click.
- **Import a calendar:** **Import…** on the Calendar page reads an .ics file from Outlook or Google Calendar. Tick the events you want and choose a student for each; the rest are remembered as skipped. Events without a student appear in the calendar under **Other**. When you import the same calendar again, **Tick all shown** leaves out events already in Supervisor, and ticking one yourself warns that it will show twice.
- **Google Calendar:** a **Google Calendar** button on meetings, visits and the viva (and in the calendar's right-click menu) opens Google Calendar with the event filled in and the student as a guest. For Google Meet meetings without a link, Google adds one. Click Save there to send the invitation.
- **Weeks starting on Sunday:** choose Monday or Sunday in **Settings › Calendar**.
- **Fold sections away:** click a section heading in a student's details (Details, Grant, Project dates, Meetings…) to fold it away, and click again to show it.
- **Jump to a role:** click a role tag under the student's name (BEng, PhD, Advisee…) to go straight to that section.
- **Privacy mode:** **Hide names** at the top of the dashboard hides students' names and B numbers on the dashboard, in the student lists, in the calendar and in every student's details. Upcoming items and calendar entries still show, without the name. Click **Show names** to bring them back.
- **Hide a student's details:** the eye on a student's Details hides their name, number and email. In privacy mode, the same eye shows them for that student only.
- **Marks:** each project coursework has Marker 1, Marker 2 and Agreed marks. For SUST students: a tick for when the SUST supervisor has sent their marks, their mark, your own mark and the agreed one. Marks show as dots: click **Reveal marks** (or any of the dots) to see and type them. When Marker 2's mark is within 10% of Marker 1's (the supervisor's; for SUST students, your own), the agreed mark is filled in with their average: click **Confirm**, or type another mark. When it is further away, a warning shows by how much, and nothing is filled in.
- **SUST first contact:** as for advisees, note when you contacted the student, their reply and when they replied. No reply shows under Needs attention.
- **Grant end worked out:** for students on a Brazilian programme, the grant starts with the project unless you give it its own start date. Its end date is worked out from the length, and you can change it with **Change…**.

### Fixes
- Meeting links copied without `https://` (for example `meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij`) are now kept in exported and invite files. Before, they were left out.
- Exported files now show the meeting link as the event's location.

### Notes
- Google Calendar doesn't keep guests or Meet links when you import an .ics file into it. Use the **Google Calendar** button to send invitations from Google.
- Existing data files open unchanged. Update every computer you use, as older versions would drop the new information.
